original_ai_output.title_zh: 非洲疾控中心调查埃博拉应对资金失踪问题
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 非洲疾控中心（Africa CDC）就刚果（金）埃博拉应对中超过7亿美元捐助资金去向不明一事要求问责。非洲疾控中心主任让·卡塞亚称，捐助方表示已拨付9.62亿美元给执行伙伴，但与刚果（金）卫生当局的联合核查仅能追踪到略超2亿美元。该消息来自单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 非洲疾控中心要求对刚果（金）埃博拉应对中超过7亿美元资金问责
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) is demanding accountability for more than $700 million in funding intended to fight Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC)

key_facts.fact: 非洲疾控中心主任卡塞亚称捐助方表示已拨付9.62亿美元给执行伙伴
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: donors say they disbursed $962 million to implementing partners

key_facts.fact: 联合核查仅能追踪到略超2亿美元用于埃博拉应对的结构
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a joint verification exercise with Congolese health authorities could only trace slightly more than $200 million to the structures actually involved in the Ebola response

key_facts.fact: 卡塞亚在金沙萨新闻发布会上谴责资金追踪缺乏透明度
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Speaking at a press conference in Kinshasa on Wednesday, October 14, Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya denounced what he described as a lack of transparency in tracking funds disbursed by international partners

uncertainties: 资金去向尚未查明，核查未能追踪到大部分资金
目前仅一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
